## Description

<!-- Brief description of the changes -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor`: Code restructuring
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation only
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvement
- [ ] `test`: Tests only
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance (deps, CI, tooling)

## Checklist

### Code quality
- [ ] `make test` passes (or `make test-unit` at minimum)
- [ ] `make lint` produces no warnings
- [ ] `oh deploy && oh deploy --check` passes (if agents/skills changed)

### Documentation (if user-facing change)
- [ ] Documentation updated or created (guide, reference, or CLI docs)
- [ ] Bilingual docs provided (FR + EN) for `docs/guides/`, `docs/reference/`, `docs/architecture/adr/`
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md `[Unreleased]` section updated

### Architecture (if applicable)
- [ ] ADR created if 2+ alternatives were considered
- [ ] Existing ADRs updated if superseded

> See [ADR-037 — Documentation Policy](docs/architecture/adr/037-documentation-policy.en.md) for full documentation requirements.
